name: DYNAMOS
description: A non-diagnostic systems-architecture framework for describing how a human cognitive-behavioral system operates under meaning, load, interaction, context, and time.
principles: No single dimension produces a trait.
Every interpretation is conditional and context-sensitive.
The same surface pattern may arise from more than one underlying architecture.
Withdrawal is not framed as failure.
Regulation and compensation strategies are not deficits.
Diagnostic labels are optional annotations, never organizing categories.
Sustainability matters as much as capacity.
Context is treated as structure, not noise.
